features.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
features.desired_outcome: Display clear, friendly introductory guidance and UI callouts during the first few steps of the initial route.
features.reason: First-time players need welcome tooltips at step 0 to understand initial movement and combat mechanics.

features.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
features.desired_outcome: Add an in-game ledger or collection tracker showing item counts and completion percentages per route.
features.reason: Explorers and collectors desire an in-game tracking interface for unique route items and completion rewards.

features.title: Thematic Cosmetic Pack Expansion
features.desired_outcome: Introduce a fresh batch of region-themed cosmetic items and hats to the marketplace.
features.reason: With 7 cosmetics currently available, collectors quickly acquire them and look for additional customization pieces themed after specific routes like Ember Forge or Moon Shrine.

features.title: Elite Enemy Waves & Aggressive Encounter Pacing on Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.desired_outcome: Add elite enemy variants and increased encounter frequency to routes with difficulty 3 or higher.
features.reason: Current high-difficulty routes feature sparse enemy spacing, making combat feel trivial rather than challenging.

features.title: Enemy Bounty Coin Drops
features.desired_outcome: Configure minor coin yields (e.g., +2 to +5 coins) upon defeating standard route enemies to smooth out the currency curve.
features.reason: In the play trace, defeating Goblins yielded no direct coin feedback, making combat feel economically neutral despite its danger.

features.title: Marketplace Wishlist & Savings Tracker
features.desired_outcome: Add a UI wishlist indicator in the marketplace showing how many more runs are needed to afford locked high-tier items.
features.reason: Encountering the 'Not enough coins' message on the Waypoint Crown with only 21 coins left can feel abrupt without a progress indicator.

features.title: Keyboard Navigation Shortcuts for Marketplace & Inventory
features.desired_outcome: Add hotkey indicators and direct keyboard mapping for common marketplace and menu actions.
features.reason: Improves overall keyboard usability and reduces input friction during shopping sessions.

features.title: Movement Command Input Buffering
features.desired_outcome: Movement inputs queued against obstacles are filtered or buffered safely until the obstacle is cleared.
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows players attempt to queue walk commands against active hazard collisions. Buffering or ignoring invalid movement commands improves handling feel.

features.title: Elite Enemy Behavior Profiles for Difficulty 3+ Routes
features.reason: Combat challengers reported low enemy encounter density and mechanical friction on high-tier routes.

features.title: High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States
features.reason: Accessibility council noted that marketplace navigation and UI elements need clearer keyboard focus rings.

features.title: Movement Command Validation & Obstacle Input Buffering
features.reason: Edge-case telemetry shows redundant walk commands attempting to queue against active hazard collisions.

policy.accept_means: authorize staged implementation/validation; it does not authorize automatic merge or bypass tests
